```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F)
library(pheatmap)
library(ptmixed)
```

Load data:
```{r}
data = read.csv('../data/data_up_to_LoA.csv')
data.cc = data[complete.cases(data$NSAA_tot),]
```

Spaghetti plot:
```{r}
make.spaghetti(
  x=age
  , y=NSAA_tot
  , id=Patient_ID
  , data=data.cc
)
```

Heatmap:
```{r heatmap}
df.proteins = read.csv('../data/proteins_round2.csv')

mat.proteins = subset(data.cc, select=df.proteins$x)
mat.proteins.scaled = t(scale(mat.proteins))

col.annotation = data.frame(
  # Patient    = data.cc$Patient_ID,
  # Timepoint  = timepoints,
  NSAA_tot    = data.cc$NSAA_tot,
  Ambulation = ifelse(data.cc$NSAA_tot == 0, 'Non-ambulant', 'Ambulant')
)
rownames(col.annotation) = colnames(mat.proteins.scaled)

png(filename = '../plots/heatmap_seven_proteins.png', res=150, width=1200, height=900)
pheatmap(
  mat.proteins.scaled,
  breaks=seq(-3,3, length.out=101),
  annotation_col=col.annotation,
  clustering_distance_cols = 'correlation',
  clustering_distance_rows = 'correlation',
  clustering_method='ward.D2',
  show_colnames= FALSE  # patient-time labels get crowded
)
dev.off()
```
